misconceptions.description: Believing a persona is finished once a role line like 'you are a teacher' is written, ignoring audience, knowledge bound, and hard stop
misconceptions.trigger: learner saves a one-line persona that names only a role
misconceptions.feedback: A persona needs four fields: ROLE, AUDIENCE, KNOWLEDGE BOUND, and HARD STOP. A role line alone lets the model guess the other three.

misconceptions.description: Omitting an explicit do-not boundary, assuming the model will not invent facts or give out-of-scope advice
misconceptions.trigger: persona has no line that names a forbidden action
misconceptions.feedback: Add a HARD STOP line. Without an explicit boundary the model will fill gaps by inventing student details or off-topic advice.

misconceptions.description: Putting the actual task or question inside the saved persona instead of keeping the persona reusable across chats
misconceptions.trigger: learner pastes a specific homework question into the persona file
misconceptions.feedback: The persona defines who the AI is and stays constant. The task goes in your first message, not in the saved persona.
